A former harmless civil servant begins his sole struggle to alter history!
40 years ago The Rudek Kingdom was destroyed. Roa, a young civil servant in that country, miraculously survived but grew older in despair. But one day, after a long life filled with painful memories, he wakes up to find himself transported back to two years before the tragedy of his country’s destruction!
To prevent his country’s demise and protect his friends, the civil servant becomes a military strategist, using his own memories and the experiences he gained in the future to fight against the fate! Can Roa prevent the destruction of his homeland with his powerful memories and his knowledge? 
This is a story of growth and change that began with the miracle of one civil servant.

189119.synopsis:
Yun Youqing had a crush. The other person’s name was Shen Wenxin. She was straight.
Yun Youqing spoke to Shen Wenxin very freely, even boldly. She flirted more brazenly than a straight girl. She also used many cheesy pick-up lines.
“Hello, can you tell me the way to your heart?” “You’re going home, and I’m going home, too. We’re both going home. Isn’t that on the way?” “Looking at me? You like me?” “Holding my hand? You like me?” “You breathed. You like me!”
Anyway, Shen Wenxin wasn’t going to like her back, so couldn’t she at least run her mouth?
Then later— Yun Youqing: “You breathed. You like me.” Shen Wenxin took a very deep breath: “Like this?” Yun Youqing: “Like this… like this means you especially like me!” Shen Wenxin suddenly laughed, her tone very sincere. “Yes, I especially like you.” Yun Youqing: “Haha—wait, hold on?”
Shen Wenxin wasn’t straight anymore!!!
